instruction: Italicize the book title One Hundred Years of Solitude in the document

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires italicizing the book title 'One Hundred Years of Solitude' which appears in paragraph 2. Evaluator checks if this text appears in an italic run.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if 'One Hundred Years of Solitude' is italicized
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (directly accesses expected.get('book_title') since expected.type='rule' means expected IS the rules dict)
Postconfig properly saves the document before verification, ensuring fresh file state
Data flow is correct: postconfig saves → getter retrieves → metric checks italic formatting
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves the docx file from VM

However, this is unlikely in practice for typical LibreOffice Writer italic operations, which usually keep selected text in contiguous runs.
